 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It's Boise State and Colorado State in a Pac-12 college football game at Canvas Stadium.
 Boise State is chasing the first title for the rebuilt Pac-12 as well as a berth in the College Football Playoff. It's been a lopsided matchup historically, but CSU won the last meeting in Fort Collins on a last-gasp Hail Mary.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Coloradoan is bringing you live updates, scores and highlights from the game. Follow along.
 Pac-12 football standings
 05:15 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 Here are the Pac-12 standings entering Week 10:
 Boise State: 4-0 (7-1 overall)
 Oregon State: 3-1 (5-3 overall)
 San Diego State: 3-2 (4-5 overall)
 Fresno State: 2-2 (5-3 overall)
 Texas State: 2-2 (4-4 overall)
 Utah State: 2-2 (3-5 overall)
 CSU: 1-3 (3-5 overall)
 Washington State: 0-5 (1-8 overall)
 Colorado State's lone win over Boise State: The Holy Holker
 04:45 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 This is the first time Boise State has played at CSU since 2023. In that game, CSU outscored Boise State 21-0 in the final 4:01 of the game for the Rams' first-ever win over Boise State in the 13th all-time meeting.
 CSU's 31-30 win came with the game-winning touchdown a 33-yard Hail Mary on the final play of the game from Brayden Fowler-Nicolosi to Dallin Holker.
 Final Boise State vs Colorado State injury report
 04:44 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here are the gameday injury updates for CSU and Boise State.
 Boise State:
 Carson Rasmussen OL Out
 Maddux Madsen QB Out
 Sire Gaines RB Out
 CSU:
 Steph Wright DL Probable
 Mel Brown RB Questionable
 Aj Noland DB Out
 Dagan Myers DB Out
 Elijah McCantos DB Out
 Grant Houser TE Out
 Jace Bellah DB Out
 Juice Vereen TE Out
 Makhi Johnson WR Out
 Durell Robinson RB OUT
 John Holthaus OL OUT
 Pearce Spurlin TE OUT
 Colorado State injury update: Mel Brown could play
 04:31 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 A somewhat positive update for CSU. Running back Mel Brown has been upgraded and now could be available in a very limited role for the Rams.
 Colorado State's second annual "snow days"
 04:30 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 This week has been the second edition of CSU's "snow days" promotion. There was a rail jam competition during tailgate (with snow brought in on the roughly 60 degree day). Venders have been on site and the Rams will be wearing a special helmet in the game. CSU will be in all white.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here's a look at the CSU snow days helmet from its debut last year:
 FORT COLLINS, COLORADO - NOVEMBER 8: Jace Bellah #12 of the Colorado State Rams celebrates after a first quarter interception against the UNLV Rebels at Canvas Stadium on November 8, 2025 in Fort Collins, Colorado. (Photo by Dustin Bradford/Getty Images) Boise State chasing College Football Playoff spot
 04:15 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 The first edition of the weekly CFP rankings were released Nov. 3 and the Broncos come in at No. 25 overall. Boise State is the only non-Power 4 team ranked.
 Boise State is 7-1 overall with its lone loss coming at Oregon (the Ducks are No. 23 in the first CFP rankings). The Broncos escaped a nearly damaging defeat last week with a 46-45 comeback win over Texas State.
 The top-ranked Group of 6 team makes the College Football Playoff.
 Boise State vs Colorado State betting odds
 04:00 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Odds courtesy of BetMGM as of Nov. 6. 
 Spread: Boise State by 17.5 points
 Over/under: 69 points
 Boise State QB Maddux Madsen injury report
 03:45 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 ESPN's Pete Thamel reported on Nov. 6 that Maddux Madsen will be out for Boise State against CSU. He was injured in last week's game against Texas State.
 Madsen has completed 148 of 222 passes for 1,681 yards, 15 touchdowns and just one interception. He's thrown for more than 8,000 yards in his college career and 65 touchdowns.
 Colorado State injury update: Top two running backs out
 03:32 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 Significant injury news for CSU. The top two running backs for the Rams — Mel Brown and Durell Robinson — are both out, CSU coach Jim Mora tells the Coloradoan.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Robinson has 424 rush yards (4.5 per carry) and nine rushing touchdowns (plus a receiving TD). Brown missed last week as well and he has 283 yards (6.6 per carry) and a touchdown, plus a kick return.
 Brown and Robinson out will mean Oliver Lundberg and freshmen Cedric Ross and Jayden Fox will see increased roles.
 The offense is missing more key players, too, including offensive lineman John Holthaus and tight end Juice Vereen.
 CSU's offensive out list for the Boise State game:
 RB Durell Robinson
 RB Mel Brown
 Tight end Juice Vereen
 OL John Holthaus
 TE Grant Houser
 TE Pierce Spurlin
 Boise State vs Colorado State predictions
 03:30 PM ET, November 7 2026, Kevin Lytle 
 Here are some predictions for Boise State at CSU:
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Boise State 55, CSU 23: Colorado State has the worst defense in the country. The Rams have given up 59, 56, 66, 49, and 31 points in conference games. The Broncos won't have trouble finding the end zone this week in Fort Collins, Colo. Boise State rolls to an easy victory. — John Canzano, JohnCanzano.com 
 Boise State 44, Colorado State 24 : No need to overthink this one. Boise State's Dylan Riley has the most rushing yards in the nation (1,049) and the Rams can't stop the run. QB Maddux Madsen might not play due to injury, but the Broncos have plenty of firepower. — Kevin Lytle, The Coloradoan
